text:
Priya: Heads up — incident INC-2026-042 just hit eu-west-1 (ingress 503 spikes). I'm putting wave-12 into standby. Holding our release slot at 03:00 UTC. @Liam can you confirm oncall?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled release 2026-03-22T03:00Z (wave-12) -> PAUSED due to incident tag INC-2026-042. slot state: standby. pinned_version: service-api@v2.3.1

Liam: on it. I see increased 5xx on ingress LB. tl;dr — KPIs degrading. Recommend hold until remediation or 2-hour window shift.

Omar: agree. Can we shift to fallback window at 05:00 UTC or reassign to next available slot (wave-13) to avoid cascading deploy backlog?

Priya: prefer reassign to wave-13 (05:00). Wave-12 becomes warm-standby (no rollback). We'll keep version pinned to v2.3.1 for now. @Tanya note for release notes timing.

Tanya: FYI — release notes time-sensitive. If we move to wave-13, marketing needs +1h to update assets. Can we target 06:00 to be safe?

Omar: ops prefers 05:00 to prevent night overlap. Could do 05:30 to give marketing time. Alternate: keep 03:00 and roll back the feature flag instead.

Priya: rollback feature flag is doable but it's a risky tweak across regions. I'd rather move the entire slot. Let's aim 05:30 and mark as 'downgrade-safe'.

Liam: quick check — any DB migrations in v2.3.1? If yes, pinning might block reassign. @Priya

Priya: no schema changes in v2.3.1. Only small config churn. Pin stays OK.

Omar: I'm going to create a reassign ticket and update deploybot. Command:
```
/deploybot reassign --from wave-12 --to wave-13 --new-window 2026-03-22T05:30Z --reason 'INC-2026-042' --pin service-api@v2.3.1
```

deploy-bot: acknowledge. Creating change record CR-8453. New scheduled window 2026-03-22T05:30Z. Notifying waitlist.

Priya: thanks. Please update release notes publish time to 06:30 UTC per Tanya. Also add rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/release-rollback.

Tanya: noted. I'll prep notes + banner. ping me when deploybot transitions to scheduled.

Omar: I'll attach post-incident checklist to the ticket and set canary size to 5% for wave-13.

Liam: oncall will monitor. If errors persist, we escalate to rollback & cancel window. :eyes:

Priya: closing loop — wave-12 marked standby, slot moved to wave-13 @05:30, version pinned, release notes adjusted. Thanks.
